tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check
tasks.gate: deno fmt src/ && deno task check && deno task test:all && deno run -A src/cli.ts sync --check
tasks.dev: sh -c 'while :; do deno run -A --unstable-net --unstable-worker-options src/dev.ts && break; [ $? -eq 42 ] || break; done'
tasks.tui: sh -c 'while :; do deno run -A src/tui/main.tsx && break; [ $? -eq 42 ] || break; done'
tasks.install: sh -c 'cd "$(git worktree list --porcelain | head -1 | cut -c 10-)" && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && deno install -g -f --name task -A --config deno.json src/cli.ts'
tasks.test: DB_PATH=:memory: TASKS_SYNC=off TASKS_EMBED=0 TASKS_BACKOFF= deno test --frozen -A --unstable-net --unstable-worker-options src channels
tasks.test:all: TASKS_SLOW=1 DB_PATH=:memory: TASKS_SYNC=off TASKS_EMBED=0 TASKS_BACKOFF= deno test --frozen -A --unstable-net --unstable-worker-options src channels
